clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the Stonewrought Dam, Musquash Root grows in the Wetlands. The rare root is hard to gather, and a hidden coven beneath Stormwind needs it for a brew.

Musquash Root grows in the damp ground beneath the Stonewrought Dam's falls. The mist and secluded setting make it hard to gather. Few herbalists seek it, but practitioners of the darker arts prize its chemical and alchemical properties.
